WITH side_counts AS (
  SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(*) as count
  FROM riskandmargin r
  JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.dealedge
),
avg_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(count) as avg_count
  FROM side_counts
)
SELECT 
  SUM(sc.count) as sum_of_counts,
  AVG(sc.count - ac.avg_count) as avg_excess
FROM side_counts sc
CROSS JOIN avg_count ac
WHERE sc.count > ac.avg_count

assumptions.assumption: "Above the average count" means strictly greater than (>), not greater than or equal to (>=)
"Order side" refers to the `dealedge` column in the orders table (Buy or Sell)
